notes:
Account summary:
- Product fit: heavyweight RAG/search platform for multi-tenant enterprise apps (internal knowledge + legal docs). Primary interest = embeddings + learned reranker migration to reduce false positives and improve SLA for top-1 accuracy.
- Scale: ~220M documents (mix of short legal clauses + long contracts). Current index sharded across Elastic + custom vector store. Peak QPS target: 450 qps, typical steady: 120 qps.
- Latency / cost targets: 95th percentile search latency <200ms (including reranker), budget target cost/query < $0.003 (embeddings + rerank). Want unit economics by customer segment.
- Current stack: embeddings(model-A-768) + heuristic BM25 prefilter + small transformer reranker (inference on CPU/GPU spot). Considering migrating embeddings to model-B-1024 (quantized) and replacing reranker with Redwood-provided reranker models.
- Evals-driven migration: huge focus on avoiding quality regressions. They maintain a gated eval suite: nDCG@10, MRR, hits@1, semantic-similarity on 12k holdout queries, long-tail worst-case buckets. Require automatic regression alerts and rollback hooks.
- Rollout plan discussed: 1) Batch offline embedding evals across representative slices (legal, HR, engineering); 2) A/B tests on 5–10% traffic for 2 weeks with metric gating; 3) Canary reranker rollout at 10% with automatic fallback to current model on degradation; 4) Full migration after 4 weeks of stable metrics.
- Security/compliance: must support VPC private deployment or on-prem variant for certain EU/legal tenants. Require SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs, and data residency enforcement for EU customers. SOC2 is baseline; ISO/IEC desirable.
- Observability needs: per-route latency/cost breakdown, token-level cost reporting, per-query rerank trace to debug regressions. Need SDK hooks for request tags to map to customer segments.
- Open questions from last call:	1) exact compatibility of Redwood reranker with their BM25 prefilter (mapping schema)	2) expected cost delta for switching to quantized 1024-d embeddings	3) support for multi-model routing (cost vs. latency policy)
- Quote from CPO on 2026-02-18 call: "We will not accept any negative delta on hits@1 for top customers — quality gate is non-negotiable."
- Commercial: interested in 12–24 month Dedicated commitment with burst capacity for enterprise days. Pricing sensitivity around embedding unit price and dedicated throughput tiers.
- Note: Legal flagged data residency clause; procurement timeline tied to legal review (2–6 weeks).

eng_notes:
Engineering asks / acceptance criteria:
- Offline eval pass: delta nDCG@10 >= 0 or within 95% CI; hits@1 no negative delta on top-tier queries.
- End-to-end P95 latency budget <=200ms for search+rerank path in Dedicated config.
- Canary automation: auto-rollback trigger when hit-rate drop >2% absolute or nDCG drop >0.015 on canary slice.
- Support for incremental reindexing: they cannot reindex entire 220M docs in one window. Need prefix KV caching + shadow indexing support.
- Cost estimation: target embedding cost <=$0.0009 per embedding + reranker amortized <=$0.002 per query to hit $0.003 total goal.
